title: Four Purple Warriors
description: Four identical poses of a dark-skinned female warrior with short silver hair, wearing matching purple and silver fantasy armor with leaf-like patterns, arm wraps, and leg bindings. The figures are arranged in a horizontal row against a solid black background, each in a dynamic combat stance with purple energy effects near their heads.
